title: Love the true treasure before desire names your wealth
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 256
summary: The pauree opens by commanding love for the Lord as the true treasure. It answers desire, fear, and the fantasy of lasting wealth by saying the Name alone accompanies and enlightens.
whyItMatters: This is for anyone who feels driven by craving, acquisition, or the fear of losing it all. Kept close, it cools desire by showing what does and does not travel with you.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: love the true treasure before desire names your wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤਾ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tataa taa siau preet kar gun nidh gobidh rai ||
lines.translation: TATTA: Embrace love for the Treasure of Excellence, the Sovereign Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਛਤੇ ਤਪਤਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: fal paaveh man baachhate tapat tuhaaree jai ||
lines.translation: You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, and your burning thirst shall be quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ਕੀ ਜਾਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: traas miTai jam pa(n)th kee jaas basai man naau ||
lines.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Name shall have no fear on the path of death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gat paaveh mat hoi pragaas mahalee paaveh Thaau ||
lines.translation: He shall obtain salvation, and his intellect shall be enlightened; he will find his place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਧਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਬਨ ਨਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: taahoo sa(n)g na dhan chalai gireh joban neh raaj ||
lines.translation: Neither wealth, nor household, nor youth, nor power shall go along with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹੁ ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g simarat rahahu ihai tuhaarai kaaj ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord. This alone shall be of use to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਉ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਆਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: taataa kachhoo na hoiee hai jau taap nivaarai aap ||
lines.translation: There will be no burning at all, when He Himself takes away your fever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮਹਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: pratipaalai naanak hameh aapeh maiee baap ||32||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself cherishes us; He is our Mother and Father. ||32||

structure: First, it begins by naming the Lord as the real treasure worth loving.
Then, it speaks to thirst, fear, and liberation through a heart filled with the Name.
Finally, it ends by stripping wealth, youth, and power of their claim to permanence.
